import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Yellowtail per trip by season 1 (to understand patterns)
s1_trips = tables['trips'][tables['trips']['fished_date_season'] == 1]

# Group by doy to see seasonal patterns
doy_patterns = s1_trips.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).round(2)

doy_patterns.columns = ['yt_total', 'trips', 'yt_per_trip', 'anglers_total']
doy_patterns['yt_per_angler'] = (doy_patterns['yt_total'] / doy_patterns['anglers_total']).round(2)

# Show the peaks
print("Top 15 DOY by yellowtail per trip (Season 1):")
print(doy_patterns.nlargest(15, 'yt_per_trip')[['yt_per_trip', 'trips', 'yt_per_angler']])

print("\n\nSeason 1 doy 280-310 (October peak window):")
print(doy_patterns.loc[280:310, ['yt_per_trip', 'trips', 'yt_per_angler']])

# What doy are we at in season 2 day 60?
s2_data = tables['trips'][tables['trips']['fished_date_season'] == 2]
print("Season 2 data range (day 60):")
print(f"DOY range: {s2_data['fished_date_doy'].min():.0f} to {s2_data['fished_date_doy'].max():.0f}")
print(f"Count by doy in season 2:")
s2_by_doy = s2_data.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).reset_index()
s2_by_doy['yt_per_angler'] = (s2_by_doy['yt'] / s2_by_doy['anglers']).round(2)
print(s2_by_doy.tail(20))

print("\n\nMost recent trips in season 2:")
print(s2_data[['fished_date_doy', 'boat', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers']].tail(20))
